Serilog.title: Serilog
Serilog.description: Serilog's configuration. Joinery.Dovetail.Serilog reads the minimum level and its overrides from it; sinks and enrichers are configured by Serilog joints in code.

Serilog.Level.title: Log level
Serilog.Level.description: A Serilog log level threshold: one of Serilog's six levels, matched by name.

Default.description: The minimum level for sources without an override.

Override.title: Minimum level overrides
Override.description: Minimum levels per logging source: the key is a source context (a namespace or type name prefix, such as Microsoft.AspNetCore), the value a level.

^(?:[Dd][Ee][Ff][Aa][Uu][Ll][Tt])$.description: The minimum level for sources without an override.

^(?:[Oo][Vv][Ee][Rr][Rr][Ii][Dd][Ee])$.title: Minimum level overrides
^(?:[Oo][Vv][Ee][Rr][Rr][Ii][Dd][Ee])$.description: Minimum levels per logging source: the key is a source context (a namespace or type name prefix, such as Microsoft.AspNetCore), the value a level.

MinimumLevel.title: Minimum level
MinimumLevel.description: The minimum level of events to emit: a level name, or an object with Default and Override.

^(?:[Mm][Ii][Nn][Ii][Mm][Uu][Mm][Ll][Ee].title: Minimum level
^(?:[Mm][Ii][Nn][Ii][Mm][Uu][Mm][Ll][Ee].description: The minimum level of events to emit: a level name, or an object with Default and Override.
